views.name: player_career_dates
views.body_sql: SELECT player_id, debut AS debut_date, final_game AS final_game_date FROM player
views.description: For each baseball player, determine their earliest debut date and latest final game date across all recorded games.

views.name: player_career_spans
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(SUBSTR(debut_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(final_game_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)), 2) +
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(SUBSTR(debut_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(final_game_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)) / 12.0, 2) +
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(SUBSTR(debut_date, 10, 2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(final_game_date, 10, 2) AS INTEGER)) / 365.0, 2) AS career_span_years
FROM player_career_dates
views.description: Compute each player's career span in decimal years by calculating the absolute differences in years, months, and days between debut and final dates, dividing months by 12 and days by 365, rounding each component to two decimal places, and summing them.
